tools.name: get_csv_example
tools.description: Return a fixed synthetic CSV and its column schema. Free, no key or quota. Copy the structure, then supply your own CSV to validate_csv.

tools.name: view_csv_demo
tools.description: Validate the fixed example with the current engine. Free and no arguments; demonstrates duplicate, email, amount and date findings. Custom files require validate_csv and paid access.

tools.name: get_csv_usage
tools.description: Read remaining operations and expiry for the API key supplied in the Authorization header. Does not consume credit.

tools.name: get_table_example
tools.description: Return fixed synthetic left/right tables and a reusable join recipe. No arguments, key or credit. Copy the structure for reconcile_tables; mode controls which unmatched rows appear in output.

tools.name: view_table_demo
tools.description: Join the bundled fixed tables and show changed and unmatched records. No arguments, key or credit. This cannot process custom data; use reconcile_tables with a paid key for your files.

tools.name: inspect_table
tools.description: Profile a CSV or explicit string table before writing a recipe. Return empty, distinct and duplicate-value counts per column and complete formula warnings; no schema or business validity is inferred. Supply CSV OR columns/rows, never both. JSON numbers must be encoded as strings so identifiers keep

tools.name: prepare_table
tools.description: Select, rename, derive and convert columns using a caller-owned version-1 recipe. Rules reference original input headers; output follows recipe order and omitted columns are listed. All input rows remain. Any failed conversion returns valid=false, all findings and csv_text=null, never a partially tr

tools.name: reconcile_tables
tools.description: Join two bounded tables using exact string or composite keys. Both sides must have non-empty unique keys: duplicates block the entire output, including many-to-many matches. Choose left, inner or full retention explicitly; unmatched records are reported even if excluded. Optional compare fields flag

tools.name: validate_csv
tools.description: Check a CSV against your explicit schema; return all issue counts and at most 200 detailed findings. Headers match exactly; required=false permits empty cells, not missing headers. Unique compares raw non-empty strings. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD, decimals use a dot without grouping, booleans use true/fal

tools.name: clean_csv
tools.description: Apply only requested column renames and transformations, then validate the output against schema. Cleanup column names refer to the original headers; schema names refer to the renamed output. Transformations run in listed order. decimal_comma changes only plain numbers such as 12,50; ambiguous group

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_csv_usage" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read remaining operations and expiry for the API key supplied in the Authorization header. Does not consume credit.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: view_csv_demo, validate_csv · Private data: view_csv_demo, get_csv_usage, view_table_demo, prepare_table, reconcile_tables, clean_csv · Public sink: view_csv_demo, reconcile_tables · Destructive: clean_csv.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: view_csv_demo, validate_csv · Private data: view_csv_demo, get_csv_usage, view_table_demo, prepare_table, reconcile_tables, clean_csv · Public sink: view_csv_demo, reconcile_tables · Destructive: clean_csv

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
